what: metrics-level reading of a finished run: AUC decomposition, error in time, success margins, checkpoint curves, hand-object distance and correlations

thresholds.note: the first four are the kit's own; both success rates threshold the TIME-AVERAGED error, so a clip passes or fails once

caveat_part_e: the boxes exported object trajectories only, so the achieved palm was never recorded. Hand-object distances use the REFERENCE palm and so measure 'the hand went where it should and the object did not follow', assuming body tracking is good.

correlations.what: Spearman rank correlation of kit AUC against each clip property, over the clips where both are defined. Rank, not linear, because none of these is normal.

hand_object.frame: simulator; palms and both object tracks come from the same staged motion
